text_en: Ah, the proud garland of the drunkards of Ephraim, and the fading flower of its glorious beauty, which is on the head of those bloated with rich food, of those overcome with wine!
text_cn: 祸哉，那为酒灌倒的厄弗辣因醉汉所骄矜的冠冕！祸哉，那生于肥谷之巅作她美饰的残花！

text_en: See, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong; like a storm of hail, a destroying tempest, like a storm of mighty, overflowing waters; with his hand he will hurl them down to the earth.
text_cn: 看哪！吾主兴起一位强有力者，有如带冰雹的暴雨，又如摧毁性的狂风，和涨溢泛滥的大水，猛力将一切抛落地上。

text_en: Trampled under foot will be the proud garland of the drunkards of Ephraim.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因醉汉所骄矜的冠冕，必被人踏在脚下；

text_en: And the fading flower of its glorious beauty, which is on the head of those bloated with rich food, will be like a first-ripe fig before the summer; whoever sees it, eats it up as soon as it comes to hand.
text_cn: 生于肥谷之巅作她美饰的残花，将如夏季前早熟的无花果，人一见到便伸手摘取吞下。

text_en: In that day the Lord of hosts will be a garland of glory, and a diadem of beauty, to the remnant of his people;
text_cn: 到那一天，万军的上主将亲作他残余的百姓的荣冠和华冕；

text_en: and a spirit of justice to the one who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
text_cn: 他将是坐堂判案者的公义之神，将是城门前御敌者的力量。

text_en: These also reel with wine and stagger with strong drink; the priest and the prophet reel with strong drink, they are confused with wine, they stagger with strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in giving judgment.
text_cn: 连这些人也因清酒而摇晃，因浓酒而蹒跚；他们在异象中摇晃，在审断时晕眩。

text_en: All tables are covered with filthy vomit; no place is clean.
text_cn: 一切筵席上都满了呕吐，没有一处不是垢物。

text_en: “Whom will he teach knowledge, and to whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from milk, those taken from the breast?
text_cn: 他要将智识授给谁呢？向谁解释启示呢？是向方才断乳和刚离母怀的婴儿吗？

text_en: For it is precept upon precept, precept upon precept, line upon line, line upon line, here a little, there a little. ”
text_cn: 这只是些“命上加命，命上加命，令上加令，令上加令，这里一点，那里一点！”

text_en: Truly, with stammering lip and with alien tongue he will speak to this people,
text_cn: 是的，上主要用口吃的唇，异人的舌，向这民族说话！

text_en: to whom he has said, “This is rest; give rest to the weary; and this is repose”; yet they would not hear.
text_cn: 虽然他曾对他们说过：“这就是安息的地方，让困倦的人安息吧！这就是休养的处所。”可惜他们总不肯听从。

text_en: Therefore the word of the Lord will be to them, “Precept upon precept, precept upon precept, line upon line, line upon line, here a little, there a little; ” in order that they may go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
text_cn: 因此上主的话对他们真成了“命上加命，命上加命，令上加令，令上加令，这里一点，那里一点，”致使他们虽然前行，却向后仰倒而跌伤，陷于圈套而被掳获。

text_en: Therefore hear the word of the Lord , you scoffers who rule this people in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 为此，你们这些在耶路撒冷统治这民族的好嘲弄的人，听上主的话吧！

text_en: Because you have said, “We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol we have an agreement; when the overwhelming scourge passes through it will not come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and in falsehood we have taken shelter”;
text_cn: 你们曾说过：“我们与死亡订了盟，与阴府结了约，当狂怒的刑鞭经过时，不会落在我们身上，因为我们有欺诈作我们的遮掩，有虚伪作我们的庇护。”

text_en: therefore thus says the Lord God , See, I am laying in Zion a foundation stone, a tested stone, a precious cornerstone, a sure foundation: “One who trusts will not panic. ”
text_cn: 因此吾主上主这样说：“看，我要在熙雍安放一块石头，一块精选的石头，一块宝贵的角石作基础，信赖的人必不动摇。

text_en: And I will make justice the line, and righteousness the plummet; hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and waters will overwhelm the shelter.
text_cn: 我要以公平为准绳，以正义为权衡；冰雹将荡尽欺诈的遮掩地，洪流将冲散虚伪的庇护所。

text_en: Then your covenant with death will be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol will not stand; when the overwhelming scourge passes through you will be beaten down by it.
text_cn: 你们与死亡所订的盟必要废除，与阴府所结的约必不持久；当狂怒的刑鞭经过时，你们必被蹂躏；

text_en: As often as it passes through, it will take you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be sheer terror to understand the message.
text_cn: 每次经过，每次必要打击你们；他每朝经过，白日黑夜也经过；惟有恐怖方能使你们明白这启示。”

text_en: For the bed is too short to stretch oneself on it, and the covering too narrow to wrap oneself in it.
text_cn: 真是伸直身子床太短，缩作一团被又窄。

text_en: For the Lord will rise up as on Mount Perazim, he will rage as in the valley of Gibeon to do his deed—strange is his deed! — and to work his work—alien is his work!
text_cn: 因为上主要兴起，如在培辣亲山上一样；要发怒，如在基贝红山谷一样，为履行他的工作──他神妙的工作，为完成他的事业──他奇异的事业。

text_en: Now therefore do not scoff, or your bonds will be made stronger; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord God of hosts upon the whole land.
text_cn: 所以现在不要再嘲笑了，免得你们的绳索系得更紧，因为我听到的有关毁灭大地的决议，是来自吾主万军的上主。

text_en: Listen, and hear my voice; Pay attention, and hear my speech.
text_cn: 请你们侧耳静听我的声音，请留意倾听我的言语：

text_en: Do those who plow for sowing plow continually? Do they continually open and harrow their ground?
text_cn: 耕田的人哪有整日耕田，掘土耙地的呢？

text_en: When they have leveled its surface, do they not scatter dill, sow cummin, and plant wheat in rows and barley in its proper place, and spelt as the border?
text_cn: 当他把地弄平了以后，不是要撒上小茴香，播种大茴香，种植大麦和小麦，地边种玉蜀黍吗？

text_en: For they are well instructed; their God teaches them.
text_cn: 这是上主教给他的方式，他的天主指示他的。

text_en: Dill is not threshed with a threshing sledge, nor is a cart wheel rolled over cummin; but dill is beaten out with a stick, and cummin with a rod.
text_cn: 打小茴香不须用钉耙，打大茴香不须用碾机，而是用木棒打小茴香，用棍子打大茴香。

text_en: Grain is crushed for bread, but one does not thresh it forever; one drives the cart wheel and horses over it, but does not pulverize it.
text_cn: 五谷岂是要辗碎的吗？不是！人并不将它无限期地压了又压，而是叫碾机滚过，碾出谷粒来，并不是为碾碎它。

text_en: This also comes from the Lord of hosts; he is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
text_cn: 这也是出自万军的上主：他的计划真是神奇，他的智慧真是超绝。
